Raid Reset Calendar for WoW Classic

# WoW Classic Raid Reset Calendar

The main raids in WoW Classic are on a weekly lockout. Smaller raids, like Onyxia and Zul’Gurub have a different schedule. Our WoW Classic Raid Reset Calendar shows you all raid resets, Battleground weekends, and the Darkmoon Faire schedule.

📂 [WoW Classic](https://www.zockify.com/classic/)

📅 Last updated on July 14, 2026 .

1. [WoW Classic Raid Resets](https://www.zockify.com/classic/calendar/)
2. [Edge of Madness ZG Timer](https://www.zockify.com/classic/calendar/)
3. [WoW Classic Anniversary Realms](https://www.zockify.com/classic/calendar/)

Naxxramas , Temple of Ahn'Qiraj (AQ40), Blackwing Lair (BWL), and Molten Core (MC) have a weekly lockout. Onyxia's Lair resets every 5 days, while Zul'Gurub (ZG) and Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj (AQ20) reset every 3 days. The purple bar shows the PvP weekend schedule in Classic.

### WoW Classic Reset Time

Different raids don’t have different times of day anymore. All raid resets will happen at the same time since the Anniversary launch. The dates shown in the calendar above are based on the server time (Berlin for EU and Los Angeles for NA). The reset times match the default daily reset time.
The daily reset for US, Latin, and Oceanic servers is at 15:00 UTC. For European realms, the daily reset is at 04:00 UTC.

### Darkmoon Faire Schedule

The Darkmoon Faire is shown in the calendar above. If you want to see all dates for the coming months, you can check out the table in our [Darkmoon Faire Schedule for WoW Classic](https://www.zockify.com/classic/events/darkmoon-faire/) .

## Edge of Madness ZG Timer

“Edge of Madness” is an event in Zul'Gurub in WoW Classic. By using Gurubashi Mojo Madness Gurubashi Mojo Madness an additional boss can be spawned inside of Zul'Gurub . There are 4 bosses available but only one boss can be spawned on a given day. These bosses rotate every second Tuesday. ## WoW Classic Anniversary Realms

The Classic 20th Anniversary Realms follow the same schedule as WoW Classic Era and WoW Classic Hardcore. The available raids are tied to the phase the realm is in. Raids that are released in a later phase, are not available yet. These are the raids and phases for WoW Classic Fresh:

1. Molten Core and Onyxia's Lair .
2. Dire Maul , Alterac Valley , and Warsong Gulch .
3. Blackwing Lair , Arathi Basin , and the Darkmoon Faire.
4.
Zul'Gurub .
5. Temple of Ahn'Qiraj and Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj .
6. Naxxramas .

The build guides for all specs contain BiS lists for all phases of Vanilla. Use our [WoW Classic Tier List](https://www.zockify.com/classic/tier-list/) to find links to the build guides for the classes you’re playing.

## WoW Classic Anniversary Onyxia Reset

The raid Onyxia's Lair resets every 5 days in the WoW Classic Anniversary realms. It has the same schedule as in WoW Classic Era and WoW Classic Hardcore. Use our Raid Reset Calendar at the top of this page to see when Onyxia will reset next.

### When is the WoW weekly reset?

For US, Latin and Oceanic servers the World of Warcraft weekly reset occurs on Tuesdays at 15:00 UTC.

For European servers the World of Warcraft weekly reset occurs on Wednesdays at 04:00 UTC.

### Which content resets weekly?

The weekly reset resets raid lockouts, the great vault, world bosses and more.

### When is the WoW daily reset?

For US, Latin and Oceanic servers the World of Warcraft daily reset occurs each day at 15:00 UTC.

For European servers the World of Warcraft daily reset occurs each day at 04:00 UTC.

### Which content resets daily?

The daily reset resets daily quests and more.

## How To Use This Timer

Select your region, then use the weekly and daily countdowns as your planning clock before raid lockouts, weekly objectives, and daily loops reset. All calculations are based on UTC so you can avoid timezone drift.

If you are coming back after a break, verify your region first. Weekly reset differs between EU and US/LATAM/OCE, and that one-day difference often causes missed weekly windows.

## FAQ

Why are all times shown in UTC?

UTC prevents daylight-saving and locale differences from breaking your weekly planning.

Does the timer auto-update?

Yes. It recalculates every second and switches to the next reset window automatically.

Can I use this for both daily and weekly planning?

Yes. The homepage is built to support both long weekly planning and short daily checks.
